rules.guideline: Vitamin D repeat testing within 90 days
rules.message: Vitamin D test (82306/82652) repeated within 90 days for the same member. NAS guideline requires clinical indication documentation for repeat testing within 90 days.
CPT 82652 (1,25-dihydroxy Vitamin D) requires complex clinical indication per NAS guideline. Verify documentation.
Both 82306 and 82652 appear in the same claim. NAS guideline flags simultaneous 25-OH and 1,25-dihydroxy Vitamin D testing for clinical indication review.
93306 (complete echocardiography) with Doppler add-on codes may require bundling review per NAS guideline.
CPT 96376 (each additional sequential IV push) requires: same drug as prior push, minimum 30-minute interval, and cannot be first push. Verify timing and drug identity per NAS guideline.
